Messages.Author: jeff...@pacbell.net
Messages.Body:
Just figured I'd check on this:

Two vampires are in combat, one of which is Red List. When combat
concludes, due to massive aggravated damage, the Red List vampire is
burned, while the other goes to torpor.

Does the Trophy retrieval rule trigger?

I assume so because the rulebook didn't say anything otherwise, but
figured I'd ask because there are so many other things that are not
allowed (Taste of Vitae, Provision of the Silsila, Games of Instinct,
etc) if the combatant is not ready when combat ends. Thanks.

Jeff
